Build the survey-intensity surface in one call

Source: R/fn_survey.R
survey_surface.Rd

The package's front door for the S term: weights the records (survey_weights), assembles the continuous field (survey_field) and renders it to a raster view (survey_raster). The field is built once and never pre-binned; the raster is only a view at the resolution of template/res.

Usage

survey_surface(
  coords,
  species,
  template = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  sigma = 100,
  domain = NULL,
  min_records = 5,
  p = 0.95,
  damp = 1,
  trunc = 4,
  record_type = NULL,
  plot_types = "Plot",
  plot_weight = 1,
  basis = NULL,
  basis_weights = c(PRESERVED_SPECIMEN = 1.5),
  origin = NULL,
  rescale = c("quantile", "max", "none"),
  q = 0.95,
  invert = FALSE,
  weights = NULL,
  filename = "",
  ...
)

Arguments

coords

two-column matrix/data.frame of record coordinates (metres, in the domain's planar CRS).

species

vector of species labels, one per record.

template

a terra SpatRaster (geometry/CRS matched) or a SpatExtent; with an extent, give res.

res

cell size in map units when template is an extent.

sigma

kernel bandwidth \(\sigma\) in metres (default 100).

domain

study-domain polygon for the p95-box correction (sf / SpatVector / SpatExtent); defaults to template's extent when NULL and a raster/extent is given.

min_records, p, damp, trunc

passed to survey_weights / survey_field.

record_type, plot_types, plot_weight

plot-vs-opportunistic handling, passed to survey_field. If record_type is NULL but origin is given, it is derived with guess_record_type.

basis, basis_weights

per-record basisOfRecord and its weight multipliers, passed to survey_field (default up-weights herbarium specimens 1.5x over observations).

origin

optional dataset/origin labels (one per record); used only to infer record_type when that is not supplied.

rescale, q

bring the view onto \([0, 1]\) (defaults "quantile", 0.95); see survey_raster.

invert

if TRUE, return survey sparsity \(1 - \tilde S\) — the form the RankIndex consumes (well-surveyed ground scores low). Default FALSE returns the intensity surface \(S\) itself.

weights

optional precomputed per-species weights (skips survey_weights); see survey_field.

filename

optional output path; ... passes to terra::writeRaster.

Value

a single-layer SpatRaster of \(S\) (or \(1 - \tilde S\) when invert = TRUE).

See also

survey_weights for the per-species weights/floor, guess_record_type for flagging plot datasets.
